message: 内緒の微笑み

name: Synn
message: 「Excuse me.」

name: Helena
message: 「Hii, Synn-chan.\s04 What brings you here?」

name: Synn
message: 「The KiraFes financial results are in, so I came to deliver the report.」
Carrying the documents, I arrived at the chairwoman's office.
Helena-san greeted me with her usual smile... and surprisingly enough, Melilot-san was there too, sitting in a chair and reading.

name: Helena
message: 「Let's take a look right away, shall we? Go ahead and have a seat over there, Synn-chan.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, ma'am.」
Hmm, maybe it's not that unexpected? Considering how many books are in the chairwoman's office, it's no wonder Melilot-san is here.

name: Helena
message: 「Mm-hmm, nicely done...」
Whether she had noticed me or not, Melilot-san continued reading at her own pace, turning page after page.
If I were to describe Melilot-san in a single phrase, there are plenty of ways to put it--a taciturn librarian, a book-loving woman, someone dressed like a maid...
Yet the proof that makes Melilot-san uniquely herself, unlike anyone else, is the sound of her turning pages. It's as lovely as a refined poetic meter.

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu, it's a lovely sound, isn't it?」
While skimming through the documents, Helena-san spoke to me mischievously.

name: Helena
message: 「The sound of Melilot turning pages. It seems simple, yet no one else can imitate it.」

name: Helena
message: 「How does she manage to make such a clear, crisp sound, I wonder? Unnoticed, softly caressing the ears, so pleasant.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Helena...」
For a split second, my heart skipped a beat.
Only when she's with Helena-san does Melilot-san show a smile she never lets the students see. Aah, so she really could smile with such a genuinely happy expression.

name: Melilot
message: 「Hello, Sakura-kun.」

name: Helena
message: 「Jeez, Melilot, your greeting is way too late. No matter how absorbed you were in your book, you're making Madam Chairwoman sad, you know!」

name: Helena
message: 「As an apology, go brew us some extraordinarily delicious black tea, won't you?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Hehe, certainly.」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, for three, of course♪」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes.」

name: Synn
message: 「T-Thank you for the tea」
Fortunately, I was treated to some of Ms. Melilot's black tea.
There were no flaws in the financial statements, and Ms. Helena gave them her stamp of approval.
The black tea was delicious.
